prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: revised game exploration-map design, one full landscape 16:9 page.
Input image 1 is the user's SELECTED VISUAL REFERENCE and edit target. Preserve its illustrated open-book cream parchment, subtle stitch border, deep plum theater curtains, warm-gold hanging stars, paper scenery, round embossed paper-seal nodes, chibi hero sticker, elegant bookmark navigation and fine shadows. Keep the same balance and quiet low-contrast map interior. Do not turn the book into a plain dashboard.
Primary request: revise this map for the CURRENT game rules with LEFT-TO-RIGHT horizontal progression and horizontal dragging. This is a horizontal map design, not a vertical map. Keep the illustrated book and art style; redraw only the route/content as needed. The chapter has ELEVEN sequential stages; do NOT compress all eleven into this screenshot. Show a clean readable horizontally scrolled viewport of FIVE consecutive columns, stages 3,4,5,6,7, with subtle clipped route continuation beyond the book's left and right interior edges. Place small discreet stage numerals 3,4,5,6,7 above each column. At least two gently branching lanes, no dense tangles. Connections go ONLY to the adjacent next column on the RIGHT, with tiny right-pointing arrowheads. No vertical progression, skipped stage, same-column links, backwards arrow, or isolated nodes.
Current state: stage3 has a completed battle node; a solid warm-gold path leads to the CURRENT completed event node at stage4 carrying the familiar white-haired Carlotta head sticker and a small checkmark. Other earlier alternatives are faded. From this current stage4 node, THREE available paths branch rightward to THREE reward nodes in stage5.
Critical reward requirement: stage5 consists of EXACTLY THREE visible reward nodes and NO other node kind. Arrange those three vertically within that column, each with the SAME golden treasure-box symbol on a deep-plum round paper seal, a tiny readable '奖励' label, violet/gold available ring. Add a subtle pale-gold vertical paper band behind this ONE column, integrated into the book's paper texture. No battle, shop, rest, event, flag, boss in stage5. Reward is free, no fight, no price. One tidy paper hover ticket just ABOVE the reward column, not covering routes or tabs: heading '奖励节点', three short lines '无需战斗', '贝币 +15', '未拥有藏品二选一'. Do not add loot piles or gacha graphics.
Future stages6 and7 each have two or three faded paper seals for battle, shop, event or rest, connected by dashed gray-violet lines. Give every displayed future node an incoming and onward route, clipping continuation at the right viewport edge. Future nodes do not have checkmarks or active rings. The stage11 boss is outside the viewport; show its icon only in the legend, do not falsely put a boss at stage7.
Top fixed UI: exactly THREE red exploration hearts and a silver shell coin '50' on the left; bookmark tabs '地图', '牌组 10', '藏品 1', '规则' across the upper right, active 地图 deep plum and others ivory; a separate small home icon button '主界面' at far right. Do not add a big page title or chapter heading. Navigation belongs above the book interior and stays fixed while the route scrolls.
Bottom left a cream stitched legend ticket with EXACTLY SIX icons/labels: '战斗' crossed swords; '商店' mint tent; '休整' flame/campfire; '事件' question-mark book; '奖励' golden treasure box; '首领' purple dumpling crest. These must be six distinct node kinds. No elite. Leave the bottom-right corner as quiet illustrated paper scenery, no large button, no extra tutorial label, no scrollbar, no minimap.
Visual constraints: Chinese text legible and verbatim, all five stage columns with generous whitespace, art decoration kept outside route click zones. Ivory/gold outlines identify available state, checkmarks identify finished state, faded muted stamps identify locked future. Keep the original chibi identities. Preserve paper-theater palette and open-book presentation from the supplied image, not the more heavily ornamented newer vertical-map design. No invented currency, official logo, watermark, neon, extra menu, combat HUD or mechanics. Render one polished practical game UI concept.
